**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

Zhuāng Hēngyáng's 8-juan mathematical compendium, posthumously assembled by his descendants from his working notebooks (*cángǎo* 殘藁) prepared during his official service as a hydraulic-engineering Circuit Intendant. The work is methodologically synthetic-and-pedagogical, drawing principally on:

- The [KR3f0048](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3f/KR3f0048) *Shùlǐ jīngyùn*'s line-surface-solid (*xiànmiàntǐ*) categorical apparatus
- The [KR3f0047](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3f/KR3f0047) *Jǐhé yuánběn* (Euclid 6 books) for plane-geometric foundations
- [梅文鼎](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%A2%85%E6%96%87%E9%BC%8E) Méi Wéndǐng's [KR3f0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3f/KR3f0026) *Lìsuàn quánshū* for the broader synthetic methodology
- The [KR3f0013](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3f/KR3f0013) *Xīnfǎ suànshū* for the *Qīzhèng bùfǎ* (Seven-Regulator step-methods) section at the end

The Sìkù 提要 explicitly frames the work's value as *condensation-and-abridgment*: the [KR3f0048](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3f/KR3f0048) *Shùlǐ jīngyùn*'s line-surface-solid sections alone exceed 30 *juàn*; the [KR3f0047](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3f/KR3f0047) *Jǐhé yuánběn* is 5 *juàn*; the [KR3f0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3f/KR3f0026) *Lìsuàn quánshū* is 60 *juàn*. The combined volume of these foundational works is too substantial for non-specialist learners to engage with. Zhuāng Hēngyáng's *Zhuāngshì suànxué* abridges this material into 8 *juàn*, "*selecting-and-raising the refined-essentials, separately gathering-and-collecting, condensed-but-not-leaking, summarized-but-not-branching*" — providing an accessible entry-point.

The 提要's verdict: "*although [the work] cannot greatly have something to discover, as a beginner-enlightenment resource for learners — [it has] particular benefit*".

For the foundational works the *Zhuāngshì suànxué* draws on, see [KR3f0026](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3f/KR3f0026), [KR3f0047](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3f/KR3f0047), [KR3f0048](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3f/KR3f0048), [KR3f0013](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR3/KR3f/KR3f0013). For Zhuāng Hēngyáng's biography, see [莊亨陽](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8E%8A%E4%BA%A8%E9%99%BD).
